watch.summary: A streamer almost misidentifies the language spoken in Brazil, secretly Googles it on screen, and then loudly claims he knew it was Portuguese all along.

beats.what: Streamer starts to refer to a Brazilian viewer's language as Spanish.
Streamer pauses and Googles 'what do they speak in brazil' with a dial-up sound effect.
After seeing the Google result, streamer immediately confidently claims everybody knows they speak Portuguese.
Streamer breaks into laughter while denying he was about to say 'Brazilian'.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: Everybody knows they speak Portuguese in Brazil bro, I definitely wasn't going to say that's Brazilian.
watch.why: The relatable panic of secretly Googling basic trivia mid-sentence creates a funny beat. His immediate switch to smug confidence after finding the answer completes the joke.
